requirements.statement: Provide adult personal local mode without a cloud account.
requirements.acceptance: Create and reopen a Page in airplane mode without service login.

requirements.statement: Create and edit Pages transactionally in the encrypted vault.
requirements.acceptance: A process interruption never corrupts the last committed revision.

requirements.statement: Search private Pages locally.
requirements.acceptance: Search returns local matches without a network request or server index.

requirements.statement: Encrypt media and sensitive temporary files.
requirements.acceptance: Filesystem and crash-path inspection finds no plaintext imported media in app-managed persistence.

requirements.statement: Show accurate per-item storage and sharing labels.
requirements.acceptance: Local save, backup pending, backed up and shared states cannot display the same ambiguous success label.

requirements.statement: Export a versioned encrypted archive with usable recovery instructions.
requirements.acceptance: An authorized user restores the exported fixture on a clean device without the original service session.

requirements.statement: Support explicit local deletion with scope explanation.
requirements.acceptance: Deletion removes local records/media and explains separate backups and recipient copies.

requirements.statement: Fail closed when secure native vault storage cannot initialize.
requirements.acceptance: Unsupported secure storage never falls back to plaintext SQLite, AsyncStorage or browser storage.

requirements.statement: Separate account reset from vault recovery.
requirements.acceptance: Account reset alone cannot decrypt; valid recovery material or a trusted device can restore a complete archive.

requirements.statement: Make encrypted cloud backup optional and recovery-tested.
requirements.acceptance: No backup upload occurs before explicit enablement and recovery confirmation.

requirements.statement: Finalize immutable snapshots with expected-head conflict checks.
requirements.acceptance: Concurrent stale-head finalization preserves both branches and cannot silently overwrite a valid snapshot.

requirements.statement: Authenticate new-device key enrollment beyond a server-supplied key.
requirements.acceptance: A substituted recipient public key cannot gain vault access without trusted verification.

requirements.statement: Revoke future device grants and disclose copy limitations.
requirements.acceptance: A revoked device cannot obtain fresh download grants while the UI avoids promising remote deletion of old copies.

requirements.statement: Version and rotate keys with resumable migration.
requirements.acceptance: Interrupted rotation preserves a recoverable valid state and old keys cannot decrypt new-epoch data.

requirements.statement: Offer grouped opt-in visual chapters and persistent theme choice.
requirements.acceptance: All ten stages render; birthdays do not force a redesign or alter accessibility choices.

requirements.statement: Separate age assurance and capability authority from visual themes.
requirements.acceptance: Age-17 and age-18 Horizon fixtures have different policy states; editable metadata and client clocks cannot grant adulthood.

requirements.statement: Require approved adult/guardian assurance before real child processing.
requirements.acceptance: Unverified or disputed relationships cannot create an active child-processing grant.

requirements.statement: Record purpose-specific consent and withdraw dependent processing.
requirements.acceptance: Withdrawal blocks new and queued dependent disclosures while preserving appropriate receipt history.

requirements.statement: Separate child-history, parent-private and shared collections.
requirements.acceptance: A grant to one collection never unlocks the others or all family data.

requirements.statement: Provide an independently verified adult ownership transition.
requirements.acceptance: Guardian authority does not silently persist after adulthood; disputed or incomplete transfer does not expose content.

requirements.statement: Support joining at 50+ and 65+ with current goals.
requirements.acceptance: A 58- or 72-year-old can onboard without entering childhood history or accepting a caregiver role.

requirements.statement: Make trusted-delegate access explicit, scoped and revocable.
requirements.acceptance: A delegate assigned an event task cannot read the private vault or recover keys.

requirements.statement: Use intentionally selected local interests.
requirements.acceptance: Interest changes update local suggestions without creating a server behavioral profile.

requirements.statement: Provide editable self-directed goals with pause and reset.
requirements.acceptance: Users can change or pause goals without lost history, shame or inferred career destiny.

requirements.statement: Provide optional local reminders with quiet hours and timezone handling.
requirements.acceptance: Duplicate recurrence and timezone changes do not create repeated reminders; disabling stops future scheduling.

requirements.statement: Publish only reviewed age-suitable activities with sources.
requirements.acceptance: Unreviewed or expired high-stakes content is not published by an AI output or organization author.

requirements.statement: Avoid coercive streaks, comparison and stereotyped goals.
requirements.acceptance: Skip and break flows remain neutral; no beauty, femininity or child productivity ranking exists.

requirements.statement: Maintain complete source-backed opportunity records.
requirements.acceptance: Published listings include organizer, source, eligibility, deadline/timezone, cost or explicit unknown and verification date.

requirements.statement: Separate listing authoring from approval and track revisions.
requirements.acceptance: An organization author cannot self-publish and a material source change triggers review.

requirements.statement: Match opportunities locally with understandable reasons.
requirements.acceptance: A match cites selected criteria; unknown eligibility stays unknown and private Pages are not uploaded.

requirements.statement: Suspend expired, unsafe or unverifiable actionable listings.
requirements.acceptance: Deadline expiry disables application actions and displays the correct status rather than a stale recommendation.

requirements.statement: Disclose external application destinations and required age gates.
requirements.acceptance: Handoff shows the destination and does not claim submission without an actual receipt.

requirements.statement: Verify organizations and constrain their staff roles.
requirements.acceptance: Unverified organizations cannot publish; revoked staff cannot operate through stale sessions.

requirements.statement: Expose only consented applications to the correct organization/program.
requirements.acceptance: Cross-organization reads, updates and exports fail; no directory of non-applicant girls exists.

requirements.statement: Apply suppression and purpose limits to partner aggregates.
requirements.acceptance: Small-cell reports cannot reveal an individual through drill-down or repeated filters.

requirements.statement: Gate adult groups by current eligibility and operating readiness.
requirements.acceptance: Unknown/minor users and disabled moderation coverage cannot enter adult-only posting routes.

requirements.statement: Provide report/block controls and confidential case handling.
requirements.acceptance: Reporting does not reveal the reporter to the reported account and blocked contact routes are denied.

requirements.statement: Record moderation decisions and appeals with least privilege.
requirements.acceptance: Only assigned reviewers access cases; decisions have reasons and an accessible appeal route.

requirements.statement: Disable open minor profiles and adult-minor direct messaging.
requirements.acceptance: Direct API calls cannot bypass the restriction, even with an adult-looking theme or mentor role.

requirements.statement: Use bounded mentor programs and honest verification badges.
requirements.acceptance: Mentor scope, checks and dates are visible; no badge grants private minor contact.

requirements.statement: Offer offline verified official help resources without payment/login.
requirements.acceptance: The directory opens while logged out/offline and shows country/source/review date.

requirements.statement: Distinguish dialer handoff from emergency dispatch.
requirements.acceptance: No dispatch, rescue or arrival confirmation is displayed without a real authorized integration and evidence.

requirements.statement: Make future adult location sessions explicit, bounded and revocable.
requirements.acceptance: No location before consent/start, no remote-start by a contact and no continuation after expiry.

requirements.statement: Expose actual delivery and background-location failures.
requirements.acceptance: Queued, transport-accepted, acknowledged, stale and failed states cannot be mislabeled as help received.

requirements.statement: Keep live minor-location sharing disabled.
requirements.acceptance: Neither guardian action nor a client flag enables minor tracking in the baseline.

requirements.statement: Require adult purpose-specific selected-data cloud-AI disclosure.
requirements.acceptance: Only previewed selections reach the approved provider after fresh policy/consent checks.

requirements.statement: Constrain AI outputs to grounded drafts and no unauthorized actions.
requirements.acceptance: Invented references, unsafe instructions and injected tool requests fail validation or receive a bounded response.

requirements.statement: Block cloud processing of minor personal input in the baseline.
requirements.acceptance: A guardian submitting a child's diary is rejected before the provider call.

requirements.statement: Exclude private content and keys from telemetry and server indexes.
requirements.acceptance: Network/log/crash inspections find no private Page text, key or journal-derived embedding.

requirements.statement: Provide class-specific service export and deletion.
requirements.acceptance: Local, encrypted backup, service and recipient-copy consequences are distinguished and jobs are traceable.

requirements.statement: Enforce reviewed retention and deletion tombstones during restore.
requirements.acceptance: Restoring old service backups cannot reactivate deleted accounts or revoked grants.

requirements.statement: Limit administrators and support to purpose-scoped data.
requirements.acceptance: No staff role can browse private vaults or unrelated moderation/application records.

requirements.statement: Use durable idempotent jobs with fresh authorization before disclosure.
requirements.acceptance: Crash/retry does not duplicate effects or send after consent/role revocation.

requirements.statement: Use generic consented notification payloads.
requirements.acceptance: Locked-screen/push payloads contain no private text, exact location or sensitive child details.

requirements.statement: Enforce fresh resource authorization across API, database and storage.
requirements.acceptance: Stale JWT, editable metadata, cross-tenant IDs and revoked sessions cannot authorize sensitive operations.

requirements.statement: Fail closed for unknown or disabled sensitive capabilities.
requirements.acceptance: Client flags never enable a server-disabled community, AI, child or location feature.

requirements.statement: Separate payment entitlements from data ownership.
requirements.acceptance: A payer cannot read beneficiary vault data; cancellation preserves export and official help.

requirements.statement: Preserve portable documentation, contracts and handover in GitHub.
requirements.acceptance: A fresh environment can inspect the exact task/contract baseline without hidden builder conversation state.

requirements.statement: Support accessible contrast, text scaling, screen readers and reduced motion.
requirements.acceptance: Core consent, recovery, capture and help flows pass the documented assistive-mode tests.

requirements.statement: Externalize copy and human-review critical Telugu translations.
requirements.acceptance: Critical notices and help text preserve meaning and layout when Telugu is enabled.

requirements.statement: Establish monitored private reporting and incident/rights runbooks.
requirements.acceptance: Assigned owners complete a tabletop and no public issue contains sensitive evidence.

requirements.statement: Validate demand and privacy comprehension through ethical remote research.
requirements.acceptance: Findings distinguish observation, hypothesis and paid evidence without collecting unnecessary child data.

requirements.statement: Enforce storage/model budgets and transparent downgrade behavior.
requirements.acceptance: Quota exhaustion stops costly operations without silent data loss or blocking export/help.

requirements.statement: Publish an honest feature and verification manifest.
requirements.acceptance: Specified, implemented, tested, reviewed and released states are separate; mock integrations cannot masquerade as production.
